verses.1: The words that came from Jehovah to Jeremiah.
verses.2: You stood at the gate of the House of God, and you proclaimed this message there. You said, “Let all the Jews who come to these gates to worship God hear these words from God.”
verses.3: As Jehovah, the army of heaven and God of Israel, said: “They have corrected your ways and your sins. Now I have brought you to this place.”
verses.4: Do not trust those false words that say, “The house of Jehovah is here.” The house of Jehovah is not here.
verses.5: For if you behave properly and do what is right, and if you act with fairness between one person and their enemy, then everything will be fine.
verses.6: May there be peace and wisdom. Do not shed blood in this place. And after God, do not go against one another.
verses.7: And I have placed you in this place, in this land that I have given to your mothers for ever and ever.
verses.8: Now, you rely on those false words, without any hope of success.
verses.9: Thieves, murderers, liars, and those who betray their masters. They follow other gods, ones that they do not know.
verses.10: And you came and stood before me in this house whose name is mine. And you said, “We have been saved, so that we may carry out all these hardships.”
verses.11: The house where these outbursts of violence took place was the one whose name I have mentioned in your eyes. And now, I too have seen it, O LORD.
verses.12: Let us go to my place, which is in Shiloh. There I have placed my name. Go there and see what I have done for the sake of the suffering of Israel’s people.
verses.13: And now, since you have done all these things, let me say, “Yahweh says.” I will speak to you about this matter. But if you do not listen, then I will call upon you, and you will not answer.
verses.14: And I made a house for it, which is named after me. It’s the place where you can trust me, and where I have placed you and your ancestors. That’s what I did for them.
verses.15: And I have cast you away from my face, just as I have cast away all your descendants and all your crops.
verses.16: And you shall not pray for this people. Do not bring them any blessings or prayers. And do not harm me, for I do not hear your prayers.
verses.17: Do you not see what they are doing in the cities of Judah and in the parts of Jerusalem?
verses.18: The men cut down trees, while the women tended to the fire. They also prepared offerings for the king of heaven. They also offered sacrifices to other gods, in order to provoke my anger.
verses.19: They are angry, says Jehovah. Let them be punished for their actions.
verses.20: Therefore, thus says the Lord Jehovah: Behold, my wrath is upon this place, upon man, upon animals, upon trees, and upon all the fruit of the earth. It will not be extinguished.
verses.21: Thus said Jehovah, the God of Israel: “Reach up your offerings and eat the meat yourselves.”
verses.22: For I did not speak to your ancestors, nor did I command them to bring them out of the land of Egypt because of those things related to idols and sacrifices.
verses.23: For if I command you to do this, then you shall listen to my voice. I will be your God, and you will be my people. You shall follow all the ways that I command you, so that it may be good for you.
verses.24: And they did not hear, nor pay attention to what was said to them. They went along with their evil desires, and became like enemies to one another, rather than friends.
verses.25: From the day when your ancestors left the land of Egypt until today, I will send all my prophets to you.
verses.26: And they did not listen to me, nor did they open their ears. They became stubborn and refused to follow their parents’ instructions.
verses.27: And you said to them all these things, but they will not listen to you. And when you call out to them, they will not respond.
verses.28: And you said to them, “This is the nation that did not listen to the voice of the LORD their God. They did not take up the responsibility to destroy those who were true believers. Thus, their faith was destroyed from among them.”
verses.29: I will be filled with anger and hatred. I will throw stones at their mouths, because Jehovah has become angry and has destroyed their kingdom.
verses.30: For the sons of Judah did evil in my eyes. They covered their mouths in the house where my name is called, in order to hide it.
verses.31: And we built those structures on the ruins of Ben-Hinnom, so that they could burn their own children and their children’s children in fire. But I didn’t command such a thing, and it never entered my mind to do so.
verses.32: Therefore, see that days come, says Jehovah. No more will there be any speaking of those who are killed and buried in pits.
verses.33: And this people would become food for the birds in the sky, and for the animals on the earth. There would be no relief at all.
verses.34: And I was taken away from the cities of Judah and from the outskirts of Jerusalem. There was a sound of joy and celebration, like the sound of a bride’s voice. But now, the land will be destroyed.
